The M 6.1 earthquake on 6 November 2026 (UTC) was near **Hasaki, Japan**, about 144–156 km southeast of the town. According to a Defcon Level report, it struck at 10:39 UTC at a depth of about 29 km, and USGS rated the expected shaking harm as green, its lowest level. 22 people reported feeling it to USGS.

Sources:
- https://www.defconlevel.com/alert/2026-11-06-usgs-earthquakes-m-6-1-156-km-se-of-hasaki-japan
- https://earthquaketoday.org/japan/hasaki-japan-M6.1-us7000twg9

I couldn't load the USGS event page itself (us7000twg9) because it renders with JavaScript, so these details come from secondary sites and may differ slightly from USGS's current figures. A separate M 6.1 in the Fiji region occurred on 5 November (17:21 UTC), so it isn't the 6 November event.
